statement: ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff) (u v : KdVPlan.Path), KdVPlan.Data 0 f → KdVPlan.Data 0 g → KdVPlan.hn 0 f + KdVPlan.hn 0 g ≤ 2*R → KdVPlan.Exact gamma T f u → KdVPlan.Exact gamma T g v → KdVPlan.UB 0 0 T (fun t => u t-v t) (K*KdVPlan.hn 0 (f-g))
proof:

refine ⟨K, hK, ?_⟩
intro f g u v hf hg hfg hu hv
obtain ⟨u', v', hu', hv', huv, _⟩ := hd f g hf hg hfg
have lower := @yui_aux_0004 T gamma R h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_T001 h_T007 h_T011 h_T013
have hu0 : KdVPlan.KSol 0 T f u :=
  ⟨lower gamma 0 0 T u h_H002.1.le hu.1.1, hu.1.2⟩
have hv0 : KdVPlan.KSol 0 T g v :=
  ⟨lower gamma 0 0 T v h_H002.1.le hv.1.1, hv.1.2⟩
intro t ht
have he := hu'.2.2 u hu0 t ht
have he' := hv'.2.2 v hv0 t ht
simpa only [he, he'] using huv t ht
